blocks.text: With school, training, homework and friends, it's easy to lose track. AI can help you fit everything in.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

blocks.text: I'm in 7th grade. School is from 8 am to 2 pm. I have training on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5 to 6:30 pm. On Friday I have a biology test. Make me a schedule for this week with time for studying, rest and play. I go to bed at 10 pm.
AI can suggest a warm-up or an exercise plan for your sport. But always show it to your coach or a parent – they know what's safe for you.
A plan is there to help you, not stress you out. If you don't manage something, just ask the AI to rearrange it.
